name: Annual administration fixed costs
original_assumptions: PR #87 lower-bound fixed cost (~$1.5M staffed team + $0.7M platform) plus AI evaluation and governance and REV2 AI-oversight uplift; a standing organisation sized before any customer
evidence_quality: INFERENCE built on ASSUMPTION; no line-item derivation from obligations
applicable_obligations: SOC 1 Type 2 before a staffed client; two-deep on-call; non-author change approval; business-day operations continuity; insurance
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: A standing staffed team and management layer before the first customer; AI oversight as a separate fixed cost centre; platform cost quoted as $0.7M rather than priced
replacement_mechanisms: Workload-derived staffing with founder capacity first; coverage met by retainers until hiring is cheaper; priced infrastructure; activities borne by the sponsor where law reserves decisions
remaining_uncertainty: Founder capacity; exception rates are unmeasured; SOC 1 scope; insurance limits customers will demand

name: Annual licensing fixed costs
source: Phase II enterprise-modes.csv MD-6 (fixed_base 1.8M after REV2)
original_assumptions: Platform team 0.7-1.8M + CEO/CTO + SOC 2/pen test/insurance + sales + 1 support FTE
applicable_obligations: SOC 2, pen test, insurance, change control, on-call
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: Salaried CEO/CTO/sales roles assumed rather than derived; platform team sized conventionally
replacement_mechanisms: Founder-held management; contracted reviewers and secondary on-call; workload-derived engineering
remaining_uncertainty: Maintenance hours; whether buyers accept a one-founder vendor

name: Annual variable cost per account (AI-native administration)
source: Phase II report 10 / mode-summary.csv MD-5 vendor_variable_per_acct
original_assumptions: 53 human minutes per account-year at loaded rates (/0.75 utilisation) plus $25/account infrastructure (PAR-011 placeholder) plus AI, external and failure costs
evidence_quality: INFERENCE on unmeasured touch rates; $25 infrastructure is a placeholder contradicted 7x by the servicing-economics cloud line
applicable_obligations: Exception preparation, reconciliation, donor support under full service
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: $25/account infrastructure placeholder; all event minutes on the vendor even where the sponsor decides
replacement_mechanisms: Priced infrastructure (~$0.2-0.6 per account-year at scale); sponsor-reserved decisions on the sponsor; exception intensity varied independently
remaining_uncertainty: Exception intensity and donor contact rates are unmeasured

name: Annual charity registry costs
source: Phase II report 05 (single sponsor; marginal on a platform carrying security and SOC)
original_assumptions: Connector maintenance (400 h), stewardship (part FTE), optional licensed data, on a single-sponsor basis
applicable_obligations: Freshness limits (45 days IRS, 24 h OFAC); 180-day ceiling; free federal sources
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: A dedicated stewardship FTE; licensed data treated as required
replacement_mechanisms: Free federal sources; change-driven review; pipeline stewardship in engineering hours; licensed data discretionary
remaining_uncertainty: Ambiguous-case rates; counsel view on additional screening lists

name: Customer acquisition cost
original_assumptions: A conventional enterprise sales motion (salesperson; marketing; long cycles)
applicable_obligations: None legal; procurement and security review are contractual
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: Dedicated sales staff and marketing budget
replacement_mechanisms: Founder-led and partner-led sales measured in hours, plus contract counsel and travel
remaining_uncertainty: Sales-cycle length and conversion are unknown; founder time is the real constraint

name: Development cost
source: Phase II enterprise-modes.csv build_base (PR #87 MSP build $1.1-2.4M)
original_assumptions: A salaried team building the minimum product over 12-18 months
applicable_obligations: Production qualification: control-module review, pen test, SOC 2 Type I readiness, DR rehearsal
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: A salaried team; all effort as cash
replacement_mechanisms: Founder build with AI assistance (noncash) plus purchased independent review, pen test, audit and counsel (cash)
remaining_uncertainty: AI-assisted productivity is unmeasured; the noncash hours may take years of founder time

name: Commercial validation budget
original_assumptions: Paid research and validation activities over 6 months
replacement_mechanisms: Founder-led interviews and partner discovery (no expenditure authorized)
remaining_uncertainty: Whether founder-only validation is credible to partners

name: Partner pilot budget
original_assumptions: Capital to the first referenceable paying customer, including build, SOC 2 Type 1 and sales over 12-24 months
applicable_obligations: SOC 2, insurance, pen test, onboarding before revenue
unnecessary_conventional_assumptions: Staffed team burn during the sales cycle
replacement_mechanisms: Zero-customer burn of a running platform plus first-customer readiness and working capital
